opening.argument: The speaker promotes cryptocurrency investment programs as sources of passive income, reporting lending profits and commissions while describing returns as high as 147 percent over six weeks. He directs viewers to join his BitPetite team and presents participation as a way to pursue financial benefit. The displayed BitStrong offer requires a 100-day deposit, shows variable daily profit, and provides no early withdrawal, making the financial commitment material. Although he admits that none of it is guaranteed and the program could disappear, that disclaimer does not change the central promotion of affiliate-linked programs, returns, commissions, and recruitment into them.
